before_seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']

def get_col_blocks(seg, col):
    """Get blocks at a given column, sorted by row"""
    blocks = []
    for n in seg:
        if n['pixels'] == 4 and n['color'] not in ('c', 'G', 'B'):
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            if min(cols) == col:
                blocks.append((min(rows), n['color']))
    return blocks

print("Before click:")
print(f"  Col 23: {get_col_blocks(before_seg, 23)}")
print(f"  Col 35: {get_col_blocks(before_seg, 35)}")
